The clause names the Product and Territory and ties exclusivity to Sections 4, 5, and 9 conditions, but the term/performance-target cap is absent, creating residual exposure.

reviews.rationale: Section 9 makes ENVISION exclusively purchase the Product from SIERRA with no cap on volume or value, engaging the no-minimum-commitment policy, which treats an uncapped commitment absent a shortfall remedy as high risk. The payment terms (1/3 on order plus 2/3 net thirty) deviate from net-30 on undisputed invoices with a dispute-withholding right, a medium exposure. The price-increase clause's 90-day notice fits the fallback CPI cap's 60-day notice but lacks the required CPI cap, creating residual price exposure.

reviews.rationale: Clause 6 imposes a demand-projection supply obligation on SIERRA with no minimum purchase commitment from ENVISION; ENVISION commits to nothing and pays only for actual orders under the policy. The unfulfilled-order carve-out is vague ('just cause') and provides no shortfall remedy or liability cap, contrary to the fallback's requirement that any minimum commitment be stated in an Order Form with shortfall liability limited to the committed-minus-actual difference. Other retrieved positions (IP, liability, termination, exclusivity, payment timing, pricing, revenue share) do not address this obligation.

8. Termination. (a) Upon the occurrence of a material breach or default as to any obligation, term or provision contained herein by either party and the failure of the breaching party to promptly pursue (within thirty (30) days after receiving written notice thereof from the non-breaching party) a reasonable remedy designed to cure (in the reasonable judgment of the non-breaching party) such material breach or default, this Agreement may be terminated by the non-breaching party by giving written notice of termination to the breaching party, such termination

reviews.verification_reason: The clause supports automatic annual renewal and Section 8's 30-day cure, matching the cited playbook preferences. The fallback matches the renewal-opt-in fallback verbatim, and the medium risk follows from the deviation.
